inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: Need to identify and recruit a senior backend engineer with payments system expertise. Key requirements include 5+ years backend development experience, payment processing knowledge (PCI DSS, fraud detection, reconciliation), microservices architecture familiarity, and strong problem-solving skills. Should prioritize candidates with AWS/GCP experience, ability to lead projects, and strong communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.

define-role.generate.draft:
Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Service

Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Service
Department: Engineering
Reports To: Engineering Manager
Location: [Remote/On-site]

Summary:
We're seeking a senior backend engineer to own our payments service. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our payment processing systems while ensuring security, compliance, and scalability.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement payment processing systems following industry best practices
- Ensure PCI DSS compliance and fraud detection implementation
- Lead development of payment reconciliation services
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on payment system integrations
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical architecture decisions
- Troubleshoot and resolve complex payment processing issues

Requirements:
- 5+ years backend development experience (Java/Python/Go preferred)
- Strong knowledge of payment processing concepts and PCI DSS compliance
- Experience with fraud detection systems and reconciliation processes
- Familiarity with microservices architecture and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
- Strong communication skills for cross-functional collaboration

Preferred Qualifications:
- Previous experience working on payment systems at scale
- Knowledge of financial services industry regulations
- Experience with distributed systems and high-throughput applications
- Leadership experience mentoring junior developers
